ideas.title: The Impact of Trump's Fraud Crackdown on Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the effects of the Trump administration's fraud crackdown on vulnerable populations in Minnesota.
questions: What are the specific impacts on care workers and clients?
How does this relate to broader patterns of federal intervention in state programs?
ideas.insight: This story could explore the human impact of the fraud crackdown and potential connections to broader patterns of federal intervention.

ideas.title: FBI Investigations in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the FBI's role in various investigations in Minnesota, including subpoenas and corruption arrests.
questions: What are the specific allegations and charges?
How do these investigations relate to broader patterns of corruption in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: This story could analyze data on FBI investigations in Minnesota and explore connections to broader patterns of corruption.
